paper_source.title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs

implemented_scope: Require caller-declared same evaluator, task-set, environment, and paired case/trial rows.
Compute empirical pass fractions and exact means for one caller-declared resource metric.
Apply the baseline pass-rate floor and return the observed nondominated set when all resource measurements are present.
not_implemented: No trajectory analyzer, LLM agents, test generator, harness editor, recursive evolution, deployment selection, CI gate change, or Foundation route change.
No benchmark result from the paper is imported as evidence for this component.
license_note: No external implementation code or dependencies were copied; this component uses the Ignition repository license.
